title: A ?design=dawn link strips all Frequency styling from production for that visitor, and it sticks until ?design=off

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: the pre-paint script (lib/theme/mode.ts:229-230) saves any ?design= value into localStorage and re-stamps <html data-design>, overriding the build's SITE_DESIGN (app/layout.tsx). A Frequency build ships Frequency markup scoped to [data-design=frequency]; a visitor who opens one shared ?design=dawn link gets an unstyled site on every later visit. THE FIX: drop the preview override in production builds, or ignore any value other than SITE_DESIGN. ── FIXED 2026-10-14: the pre-paint script no longer reads ?design= or stamps data-design; it clears the stale freq-design key so stuck visitors recover on their next visit. mode.test.ts pins it.
